fusions.name: Heel Loop
fusions.desc: Throws a loop of plaited hair around the legs of a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drover's Crack
fusions.desc: Cracks a long whip of plaited hair in a full circle, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Round-Up
fusions.desc: Throws loops of hair over up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles, pulling them onto you and holding their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoked Team
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, your strands haul in unison and you deal 20% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
